newsitem.title: FINLAND: STROMSDAL SEES '97 AT LEAST MATCHING '96.
newsitem.headline: STROMSDAL SEES '97 AT LEAST MATCHING '96.

text.p: Finnish paperboard maker Stromsdal Oy said on Friday it expected 1997 earnings rising at least to last year's level, when it posted a 7.0 million markka profit before extraordinary items.

It said that a chemical pulp prices rise in May would have no noticeable effect on its annual results, providing no further rises, and said it anticipated the carton market to remain at the present level for the remainder of the year.
"Taking into account the above mentioned factors, the result of the company is expected to reach at least the level of the year 1996," it said in a statement with its four-month earnings.
It reported January-April profit before extraordinary items up 53 percent at 5.5 million markka from 3.6 million markka in the year-ago period.
